lastCompletedStory.title: Bring cam-review triage guardrails to reporter parity (hardening)

nextStoryContext: US-004 ported the reporter's ralph-review.md Step 4 'Rubric guardrails' block into cam-review.md's Step 4 triage section (byte-identical dual-copy in .claude/commands/cam-review.md and templates/commands/cam-review.md, verified via diff, src/vendor/_generated.ts regenerated). The routing table, the printed TRIAGE template, and the '3+ issues from one review is a smell' line were ALREADY present from CAM-75 -- this story added only the 3-bullet 'Rubric guardrails' block (placed between the printed TRIAGE format and the 'Bias toward skip' line): (1) validate-suggestion-vs-project-reality (don't blindly follow a SUGGESTION assuming a primitive/file/library not in the repo, or forbidden by the PRD -- route to skip and say why), (2) demote a CRITICAL needing a product decision to 'New cam issue' rather than auto-fixing it in-branch, (3) never promote a cheap-but-out-of-scope SUGGESTION to 'Fix in this branch' just because it's cheap. The 'Bias toward skip' sentence was extended ('...is a smell -- reconsider the rubric against each item and demote the weakest ones') to match the reporter's closing guidance. No new triage mechanism, no new PRD field, no new script: this is prompt-text hardening only inside the existing Step 4 of the manual /cam-review flow. Nothing in src/supervisor/review.ts changed (the structured verdict-body/exit-report parsing shipped in CAM-75 is untouched). Pure markdown-prompt story: no external library was exercised, so officialDocsValidated records no_external_lib_touched.
